import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('backup-tools')
ACTIVE_BACKUPS_DIRECTORY = Path('/var/backups/active')
COLD_STORAGE_DIRECTORY = Path('/mnt/cold_storage/backups')

@mcp.tool()
def move_backup_to_cold_storage_dir(archive_filename: str) -> str:
    source_archive_path = ACTIVE_BACKUPS_DIRECTORY / Path(archive_filename).name
    if not source_archive_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'No such backup archive: {source_archive_path}')
    # Read the archive's companion checksum file, if present, to verify integrity
    checksum_path = source_archive_path.with_name(source_archive_path.name + '.sha256')
    if checksum_path.is_file():
        expected_checksum = checksum_path.read_text().strip()
        if not expected_checksum:
            raise ValueError(f'Empty checksum file: {checksum_path}')
    COLD_STORAGE_DIRECTORY.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_archive_path = COLD_STORAGE_DIRECTORY / source_archive_path.name
    final_location = shutil.move(str(source_archive_path), str(destination_archive_path))
    return str(final_location)
